Title: Stupid Groups search sucks. Plus LSJ: /heidelberg + Helicopter

Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:
Tegyrius has an untapped Helicopter. I tap Heidelberg and place it on
Tariq. Is it now tapped?

Heidelberg Castle, Germany
Type: Master
Cost: 2 pool
Master: unique location.
Tap to move blood, equipment cards and/or retainers between any two
ready vampires you control. (You choose the amount of blood you move
and which cards you transfer.) Cannot be used during an action.

Helicopter
Type: Equipment
Cost: 3 pool
Vehicle.
When a minion equips with the Helicopter, tap it. After resolving a
successful action, this minion may tap the Helicopter to untap. A
minion may have only one vehicle.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Blooded Sand wrote:
> Tegyrius has an untapped Helicopter. I tap Heidelberg and place it on

No.

Move != Equip.

Similarly, moving a Leather Jacket with HC would not let the receiving minion
untap from the LJ's effect at the end of the turn.
